title: Torn Net — Ann Nguyen
note: A tall floral poster covered by a fine semi-transparent diamond-crosshatch net; grab and pull and the net stretches, splits along a jagged diagonal, and the torn pieces sag as tattered strips. Her steal: an art/project reveal mechanic where a visitor drags to rip a net and reveal a drawing underneath. Demo: https://bubbbly.com/torn-net
